sceneKits.title: Safari And Watering Hole
sceneKits.description: Select a few safari animals, broad-canopy trees, a meadow horizon and a pond. Keep detailed animals large and frame the page with small grass tufts.

sceneKits.title: Garden And Woodland

sceneKits.title: Beach And Island
sceneKits.description: Build a shoreline scene with palm, umbrella, towel and beach toys.

sceneKits.title: Winter And Christmas
sceneKits.description: Arrange winter characters, cabin, pine trees, pond and gifts on a snow horizon.

sceneKits.title: Space Adventure
sceneKits.description: Use the crater as ground and the spaceship as a large focal subject, with alien, astronaut and stars.

sceneKits.title: Counting And Celebration
sceneKits.description: Personified numerals, bunting and stars for a costume parade or counting page.
